title: Spicy Vegan Fajita Stew
description: A flavorful and spicy stew made with the bold flavors of fajitas, all vegan and perfect for a quick dinner.
instructions: Heat a large pot over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the chopped bell pepper and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Add the sliced fiery Mexican peppers and cook for 1 minute.
Add the fajita seasoning and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the diced tomatoes, natto, and vegetable broth. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to medium-low and cook for 10-15 minutes, or until the stew has thickened slightly.
Stir in the freshly squeezed lime juice.
Serve hot, garnished with additional lime wedges if desired.
